description: This is a JUnit test class for testing the behavior of the `StoppedKamonTimer` class within the `org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.metrics.instruments.timer` package. It verifies timer functionality such as name retrieval, duration measurement, tag retrieval, and correct duration reporting.

classes.name: StoppedKamonTimerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for `StoppedKamonTimer`, testing timer functionalities including timing accuracy and tag retrieval.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a `StoppedKamonTimer` instance for testing, created via a prepared timer and immediately stopped.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Verifies that the timer's name is correctly reported.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Ensures that the timer reports a duration greater than zero in nanoseconds.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Checks that the timer's tag with key 'segment' equals 'overall'.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Validates that the timer's tags contain exactly one entry.

methods.name: reportDurationCorrectly
methods.description: Tests that a timer measuring a sleep of 1250 milliseconds reports a duration greater than 1 second.
